newsitem.title: USA: IBP Inc to add custom pork line for Asian market.
newsitem.headline: IBP Inc to add custom pork line for Asian market.

text.p: IBP Inc said it will add 80 workers this week at its Columbus Junction, Iowa, pork plant to custom process pork for Japan and Taiwan.
"This line will enable us to custom process pork for customers in the Far East," said IBP Inc spokesman Gary Mickelson.
Mickelson said the company would not disclose the type of pork to be produced but said it will be headed to Japan and Taiwan.

On March 3, IBP laid off about 400 of the plant's 1,500 workers when it discontinued a second carcass production line at the plant. The plant continues to operate one carcass shift and two pork processing shifts.
The plant produces fresh pork cuts for retail, wholesale and food service customers throughout the world.
